series_name: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
title: KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World
synopsis: Yukito, the son of a questionable cult leader, lost his life due to the cult's ridiculous training practices. Now to his surprise, he was reincarnated into another world! It was an ideal world for him without the concept of "God" or "religion" BUT...! A unique "reincarnating in other world" adventure begins: creating a "religion" in a world without God?!
